title: 高级产品工程师
Senior product engineer
summary: 构建端到端的审核体验。
Build the review experience end to end.

text: 关于职位
About the role
从数据库到最后一个像素，负责用户阅读答案、核查来源和签署审批的完整页面。
You'll own the screens people use to read an answer, check its sources and sign it off, from the database to the last pixel.
你将负责
What you’ll do
从数据结构到界面，交付端到端产品功能。
Ship product features end to end, from schema to interface.
与设计师一起打磨审核流程的每个细节。
Pair with design on every detail of the review flow.
每周与客户讨论他们如何核查我们的工作。
Talk to customers every week about how they check our work.
保持代码快速、类型明确、容易修改。
Keep the codebase fast, typed and easy to change.
我们期待
What we look for
拥有六年以上 TypeScript 和 React 网站产品开发经验。
Six or more years building web products in TypeScript and React.
关注性能、无障碍与清晰的代码。
Care for performance, accessibility and clear code.
愿意对实际结果负责，而不只完成工单。
You enjoy owning outcomes, not just tickets.

title: 基础设施工程师
Infrastructure engineer
summary: 让每个答案快速返回 每个来源随时可查。
Keep every answer fast and every source reachable.

text: 关于职位
About the role
负责存储数百万份文档的系统，并让附有引用的答案在一秒内返回。
You'll run the systems that store millions of documents and serve answers with their citations in under a second.
你将负责
What you’ll do
设计和运行存储、搜索及模型服务基础设施。
Design and run our storage, search and model-serving infrastructure.
让部署平稳，让故障少见。
Make deploys boring and incidents rare.
构建工程师日常依赖的内部工具。
Build the tools other engineers reach for every day.
在规模增长时对成本与性能负责。
Own cost and performance as we grow.
我们期待
What we look for
拥有五年以上大规模生产系统运维经验。
Five or more years running production systems at scale.
熟悉 Kubernetes、Postgres 和至少一种主流云平台。
Strong with Kubernetes, Postgres and one major cloud.
在变更前习惯先写下设计。
You write things down before you change them.

title: 前端工程师
Frontend engineer
summary: 打造核查与审批时每天使用的界面。
Craft the interfaces people use to check and sign off.

text: 关于职位
About the role
构建客户每天使用的编辑器、引用视图和审核队列。
You'll build the editor, the citation view and the review queue that customers spend their whole day in.
你将负责
What you’ll do
使用 React 和 TypeScript 构建快速、无障碍的界面。
Build fast, accessible interfaces in React and TypeScript.
把粗略原型打磨成从容、可靠的产品。
Turn rough prototypes into calm, reliable product.
与设计团队共同维护设计系统。
Own the design system alongside design.
衡量和改善产品的实际使用感受。
Measure and improve how the product feels.
我们期待
What we look for
拥有四年以上复杂 Web 应用开发经验。
Four or more years building complex web apps.
关注动效、排版和那些没人特意提出的细节。
An eye for motion, typography and the details nobody asks for.
适应小步、频繁且谨慎的交付。
Comfort shipping small, often, and carefully.

title: 工程经理
Engineering manager
summary: 带领一支五人的产品工程团队。
Lead a team of five product engineers.

text: 关于职位
About the role
帮助资深小团队交付值得自豪的成果，同时保持高标准和可持续的工作节奏。
You'll help a small, senior team ship work they're proud of, while keeping the bar high and the pace sustainable.
你将负责
What you’ll do
带领五位工程师开发核心产品。
Run a team of five engineers working on the core product.
招聘、辅导并支持团队成员成长。
Hire, coach and grow the people on your team.
与产品和设计制定计划，保护团队的专注时间。
Plan with product and design, then protect the team's focus.
在有帮助时继续参与编码。
Still write code when it helps.
我们期待
What we look for
有两年以上工程管理经验及扎实的工程背景。
Two or more years managing engineers, and a strong engineering background.
习惯记录设计并解释决策。
A habit of writing things down and explaining your decisions.
既关注交付成果，也关注团队成员的感受。
You care as much about how people feel as what they ship.

title: 应用 AI 研究员
Applied AI researcher
summary: 设计决定产品能否交付的评估。
Design the evaluations that decide what ships.

text: 关于职位
About the role
为必须展示来源的 AI 定义质量标准，再构建能够验证这些标准的测试。
You'll decide what good looks like for an AI that has to show its sources, then build the tests that prove it.
你将负责
What you’ll do
设计引用准确性与忠实度评估。
Design evaluations for citation accuracy and faithfulness.
把审核反馈转化为更好的训练数据。
Turn reviewer feedback into better training data.
开展实验并记录发现。
Run experiments and write up what you find.
一次与一位工程师共同解决一个客户问题。
Work with one engineer on one customer problem at a time.
我们期待
What we look for
在应用机器学习或自然语言处理方面有实际成果。
A track record in applied machine learning or NLP.
熟悉 Python，能够阅读论文和代码。
Strong Python, and comfort reading papers and code.
更重视真实数据，而不是好看的数字。
You prefer honest numbers to impressive ones.

title: 评估科学家
Evaluation scientist
summary: 诚实地衡量准确性。
Measure accuracy honestly.

text: 关于职位
About the role
构建基准，判断一次变更让 Verity 变得更好，还是仅仅不同。
You'll build the benchmarks we use to know whether a change made Verity better or just different.
你将负责
What you’ll do
构建和维护评估数据集与基准。
Build and maintain our evaluation sets and benchmarks.
分析失败并向团队解释原因。
Analyse failures and explain them to the team.
与审核人协作，标注复杂案例。
Work with reviewers to label hard cases.
每周清晰报告质量表现。
Report quality clearly every week.
我们期待
What we look for
具有统计学、数据科学或机器学习背景。
A background in statistics, data science or ML.
重视实验设计与数据质量。
Care for experimental design and clean data.
能够向非科研人员解释实验结果。
You can explain results to people who aren't scientists.

title: 产品设计师
Product designer
summary: 设计团队与可核查 AI 协作的方式。
Shape how teams work with an AI they can verify.

text: 关于职位
About the role
帮助法务、财务与合规团队使用可核查的 AI。每个答案都有来源，你的工作是让核查变得轻松自然。
You'll shape how legal, finance and compliance teams work with an AI they can verify. Every answer Verity gives comes with its sources; your job is to make checking them feel effortless.
你将负责
What you’ll do
从第一张草图到发布说明，负责完整审核体验。
Own the review experience end to end, from first sketch to release notes.
每周参与客户沟通，把听到的需求转化为设计。
Sit in on customer calls every week and turn what you hear into design.
静态稿不够时，用代码制作原型。
Prototype in code when a static mock isn't enough.
一次与一位工程师和一位研究员一起解决一个问题。
Work with one engineer and one researcher on a single problem at a time.
我们期待
What we look for
拥有五年以上复杂、高数据量产品的设计经验。
Five or more years designing complex, data-heavy products.
能够解释自己的设计判断，并介绍引以为傲的作品。
Taste you can explain, and work you're proud to walk us through.
适应不确定性，耐心打磨细节。
Comfort with ambiguity, and the patience to get details right.

title: 品牌设计师
Brand designer
summary: 赋予 Verity 值得信赖的声音与形象。
Give Verity a voice and a look people trust.

text: 关于职位
About the role
负责产品之外的品牌呈现，从网站到团队举办的活动。
You'll own how Verity looks and sounds everywhere outside the product, from the website to the events we host.
你将负责
What you’ll do
维护网站、印刷品与活动中的视觉识别。
Own our visual identity across web, print and events.
设计新品发布、宣传活动和插图。
Design launches, campaigns and illustrations.
与产品设计紧密协作，让体验始终一致。
Work closely with product design so everything feels like one company.
让品牌系统整洁且易于使用。
Keep the brand system tidy and easy to use.
我们期待
What we look for
拥有四年以上品牌或传播设计经验。
Four or more years in brand or communication design.
拥有重视字体与排版的优秀作品集。
A strong portfolio with typography at its heart.
享受让许多小事物形成统一整体。
You enjoy making many small things look like one thing.

title: 客户工程师
Customer engineer
summary: 帮助新团队在头两周真正用起来。
Help new teams go live in their first two weeks.

text: 关于职位
About the role
作为新客户接触的第一位成员，帮助他们放心地将真实文档接入 Verity。
You'll be the first person a new customer works with, and the reason they trust Verity with their real documents.
你将负责
What you’ll do
主导新客户的技术接入。
Lead technical onboarding for new customers.
将 Verity 连接到客户的文档系统。
Connect Verity to their document systems.
把接入过程中的发现转化为产品反馈。
Turn what you learn into product feedback.
编写指南，让下一次接入更加顺畅。
Write guides that make the next onboarding faster.
我们期待
What we look for
有三年以上解决方案、支持或工程岗位经验。
Three or more years in solutions, support or engineering roles.
熟悉 API、SSO 和数据集成。
Comfort with APIs, SSO and data integrations.
耐心，善于用简单方式解释问题。
Patience, and a knack for explaining things simply.

title: 解决方案负责人
Solutions lead
summary: 从初次沟通到续约 负责重要客户。
Own our largest accounts, from first call to renewal.

text: 关于职位
About the role
帮助大型团队从 Verity 获得实际价值，并愿意持续使用。
You'll help the biggest teams we work with get real value from Verity, and make sure they stay.
你将负责
What you’ll do
维护与重要客户的合作关系。
Lead relationships with our largest customers.
规划同一公司内多个团队的推广使用。
Plan rollouts across many teams inside one company.
把客户声音带回产品团队。
Bring the voice of the customer to product.
通过解决真实问题实现客户增长。
Grow accounts by solving real problems, not by selling.
我们期待
What we look for
拥有五年以上面向客户的技术岗位经验。
Five or more years in customer-facing technical roles.
有服务法务、财务或合规团队的经验。
Experience with legal, finance or compliance teams.
压力下保持冷静，需要拒绝时坦诚说明。
Calm under pressure, and honest when the answer is no.

title: 招聘负责人
Recruiting lead
summary: 找到共同创造未来五年的伙伴。
Find the people who will build the next five years.

text: 关于职位
About the role
负责端到端招聘，让每位候选人无论是否加入都拥有良好体验。
You'll run hiring end to end and make sure every candidate has a great experience, whether or not they join.
你将负责
What you’ll do
从初次沟通到录用通知，负责完整招聘流程。
Run our hiring process from first call to offer.
主动发现尚未寻找机会的优秀人才。
Find great people who aren't looking.
在每一步都及时告知候选人进展。
Keep every candidate informed, every step of the way.
让公开薪资区间和招聘流程更加清晰。
Make our public pay bands and process even clearer.
我们期待
What we look for
拥有四年以上工程或设计团队招聘经验。
Four or more years recruiting for engineering or design teams.
以体贴、尊重的方式对待候选人。
A thoughtful, human approach to candidates.
和招聘速度一样重视公平。
You care about fairness as much as speed.
